issue_context.title: Support mts and cts file
issue_context.body:
https://devblogs.microsoft.com/typescript/announcing-typescript-4-5-beta/#new-file-extensions

TypeScript 4.5 add mts and cts file extension, we need support this in vite
comments: [esbuild 0.13.4](https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.13.4) also now supports this. There could be a few more tweaks needed for Vite's part.
update tsconfck to 1.1 to support resolving .mts and .cts files in solution-style projects https://github.com/dominikg/tsconfck/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#110-2021-10-06
Re-opening as the PR covers config files only, not source files.

review_comments: @bluwy but `cjs` here is supported. Should we remove `cjs` too?
The `transformWithEsbuild` function is public API that can be used for any files, so I think it makes sense to support it here.
